issues.evidence: IR PageIr.sdk_unicode_mapping_errors and TextRun.sdk_unicode_mapping_errors now propagate bounded raw SDK flags. Character count and scalar fingerprints guard correspondence with the extraction pass. Printable fallbacks are retained; invalid control/whitespace fallbacks become U+FFFD. Native and Chrome/WASM with Pdfium 8111 verify three printable/control/mixed-run fixtures, public cjk/tracemonkey diagnostics, and all-page native/WASM diagnostic parity. This exposes uncertainty; it does not recover the original Unicode.
issues.required: Keep diagnostics across IR serialization, text layers and checked comparisons. A changed-source comparison with these flags requires review, while equal bytes retain their stronger identity proof.
Retain full-page declared-Unicode and mapping-only-edit regression checks for future SDK updates. Caller-provided SDK overrides remain outside the default runtime qualification.

runtime_experiment.result: Official chromium/8111 native and bblanchon WASM builds both return the declared full-page string, and the experimental full browser matrix passes. The SDKs are not the production default; native default/bundled provisioning and reproducible WASM loading still need integration.

full_browser_matrix.scope: All-page native/WASM text, geometry and SDK diagnostic parity for 48 public PDFs; 28 appearance fixtures and geometry/robustness/limit checks. Native Pdfium 8111 supplied via explicit PDFIUM_LIB_PATH; browser uses same official SDK version with a named initialization alias.

issues.resolution: Default runtime and bundled native provisioning now use SHA-256-pinned Pdfium 8111, with the same verifier. The pinned bblanchon WASM SDK is adapted to an isolated ES-module factory. The public source has a full-page Unicode gold assertion in native and browser tests; shared independent fixtures assert full-page text and detection of Unicode-only edits with identical painting.
issues.previous_default_evidence: The original font ToUnicode stream defines a broad identity bfrange, then eight overriding bfchar entries, then p/q -> é/ê. PDF.js and pypdf independently return the declared text. Native Pdfium returns ABCU, U+009B, XABpq with mapping_error=0; current library drops U+009B. Existing text-fragment tests only establish SDK stability, not Unicode correctness.
issues.evidence: Default native SDK loaded from the verified jade-pdf cache (actual dylib confirmed with DYLD_PRINT_LIBRARIES). The public PDF now returns the full declared text, and the native/WASM full regression matrix uses 8111. Independent PDF.js inventory agrees on this document.
Strict inventories differ, but full-page sample inventories are equal after NFKC. The two engines choose presentation forms vs ordinary Arabic scalars.
issues.required: Keep compatibility equivalence separate from literal Unicode equality and reading-order validation.

issues.evidence: Native extraction includes content not included by PDF.js. Freeculture includes printer filenames, timestamps and margin numbers; the cropped fixture places portions of strings outside its view box. Shading-pattern discrepancy still needs visual/source inspection.
issues.required: Define and test both source-content and visible-page extraction scopes; do not silently discard hidden/off-page content to force agreement.

issues.evidence: The independent worker exceeds its configured 512MiB V8 old-space limit and is terminated. The coordinator continues and records resource_limited; no agreement is claimed.
issues.required: Keep process/time/memory limits. Investigate upstream CMap expansion without relaxing limits to hide the failure.

issues.evidence: SDK flags Type3 sample (6), Type3 wordspacing (66), unsigned CFF bounds (11) and French diacritics (29). Printable fallbacks remain intact. Retaining previously dropped control fallbacks as U+FFFD makes the Type3 wordspacing and CFF documents disagree with PDF.js inventories. Other readable fallbacks can agree with the independent inventory despite the SDK flag. Diagnostics expose uncertainty; they do not establish that every flagged scalar is wrong.
issues.required: Adjudicate each flagged glyph using declared font mappings, source strings and painting; keep readable fallbacks and mapping uncertainty separate.

issues.limits: Geometric horizontal order, not full tagged-PDF/table/bidi/vertical order. Short centered headings and unusual physical coordinate/font scales require further gold.
